title: right_click_select mutates pipe selection without firing on_pipe_selected — the fold's camera re-home misses the 5.8 right-click path
detail: The fold made 'a pipe was selected' have two homes that now diverge in kind: the hook home re-targets the camera, the right-click home resets the panel inline. A right-click re-select of the already-selected pipe after a banner nav never re-homes; left-click does.
recommended_fix: Fire inp.on_pipe_selected at the end of right_click_select's pipe leg (nil-guarded; the parity harness leaves hooks nil) so both pipe-select paths share one effect home.

title: Fold N-B's fiber-comment fix is incomplete — the 3.3 canon paragraph in draw_bundles still documents the removed fiber-core draw
detail: N-B deleted the first-paragraph fiber sentence but left two stale references describing a fiber-core draw that 7.1 removed — future readers will hunt for code that does not exist.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the two fiber-core sentences (view.odin:225 and 229-231) to describe the 7.1 band + inset lanes, or delete them from the 3.3 paragraph.
